allowed.entry:src/main.tsx: the browser entry point the app shell build bundles from index.html; nothing imports it.
allowed.ignore:src/worker/service-worker.ts: the service worker is its own bundle: packages/app/scripts/build-release.ts compiles it from this path (sw.verified.js) and the shell registers it by URL.
allowed.ignore:src/worker/notifications.ts: reached only from src/worker/service-worker.ts, the separate worker bundle the production entry never imports.
allowed.ignore:src/release/keeper.ts: reached only from src/worker/service-worker.ts, the separate worker bundle the production entry never imports.
allowed.ignore:src/worker/filter-document.ts: reached only from src/worker/service-worker.ts, the separate worker bundle the production entry never imports.
allowed.ignore:src/release/storage.ts: reached only from src/worker/service-worker.ts, the separate worker bundle the production entry never imports.
